manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Wormfang Drake must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Wormfang Drake for its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
